## Incident Overview

tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh adds three new tests (`test_no_review_result_in_output_contract`, `test_no_min_score_in_output_contract`, `test_three_line_output_contract`) that grep reviewer base file content. Brittle to cosmetic edits.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [12] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR — intentional contract enforcement.

## Suggested Fix

Same as [11]: accept with documenting comment, or replace with structural matchers.
